name: What is the process for getting new windows installed?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting new windows installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with a free, in-home consultation where we discuss your needs, assess your current windows, and take measurements. We then provide a detailed estimate outlining material options and costs. Once you approve, we order the custom windows. On installation day, our certified team carefully removes old windows, prepares the openings, installs the new windows, ensures proper sealing and insulation, and finishes with a thorough cleanup. We conduct a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves a consultation, detailed estimate, window ordering, professional installation with proper sealing and cleanup, followed by a final walkthrough.
